boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten current or recurring no-admission activities at Ohio University and in Athens, with direct-source access details.

cards.title: See printmaking experiments at Waves of Influence
cards.subtitle: Kennedy Museum of Art, Lin Hall
cards.notes: Walk through the exhibition’s prints by Hockney, Frankenthaler, Rauschenberg, Stella, and contemporaries; check museum hours before heading to The Ridges.
cards.short_summary: A free museum-gallery look at late-20th-century printmaking.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University lists Waves of Influence at Kennedy Museum of Art and states that admission is always free.
cards.source_title: Waves of Influence | Ohio University Calendar
cards.access_notes: Kennedy Museum of Art lists gallery hours and says admission is always free; donations are optional.

cards.title: Explore Material Matters
cards.subtitle: Kennedy Museum of Art, Lin Hall
cards.notes: Use the student-curated exhibition as a conversation starter about craftsmanship, materials, and community histories; pair it with another gallery during the same visit.
cards.short_summary: A student-curated exhibition running through March 2027.
cards.evidence_claim: Material Matters is a 2025–26 Museum Studies exhibition running April 10, 2026 through March 21, 2027; Kennedy Museum admission is always free.
cards.access_notes: Visit during Kennedy Museum gallery hours; the museum’s visit page states admission is always free.

cards.title: Make a slow lap through Kennedy Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: 100 Ridges Circle, The Ridges
cards.notes: Choose a few works or galleries to discuss instead of trying to see everything at once; museum admission is free and donations are optional.
cards.short_summary: A free art-museum visit in Lin Hall at The Ridges.
cards.evidence_claim: Kennedy Museum of Art in Lin Hall states that admission is always free.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Kennedy Museum of Art at OHIO
cards.access_notes: Summer 2026 hours are Thursday–Sunday, noon–5 p.m.; confirm hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Public Telescope Nights at the Ohio University Observatory
cards.title: Drop in for Public Telescope Night
cards.subtitle: Ohio University Observatory, The Ridges
cards.notes: Bring a friend for a faculty- and student-hosted sky watch; arrive during the listed drop-in window and check for weather-related cancellation updates.
cards.short_summary: Free public observing nights with campus astronomers.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University states that telescope nights at the Ohio University Observatory are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Public Telescope Nights at the Ohio University Observatory
cards.access_notes: Summer 2026 drop-in dates include August 21 and 22, 9–11 p.m.; events cancel for cloudy or stormy skies.

cards.title: Take a quiet reset in Alden’s Meditation Room
cards.subtitle: Fifth floor, Vernon R. Alden Library
cards.notes: Use the first-come room for silent meditation, prayer, or reflection; remove shoes if possible and leave food, conversation, and devices outside the moment.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet room for brief silent reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries says the Alden Library Meditation Room is open to students, staff, faculty, and visitors whenever the floor is open.
cards.source_title: Library Policies and Guidelines | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: First-come use only; the library asks visitors not to use it as a lounge, study room, or meeting room.

cards.title: Browse maps and public documents in Alden
cards.subtitle: Fifth floor, Vernon R. Alden Library
cards.notes: Pick a map or public document connected to a class, hometown, or travel idea and compare notes together; the collection is open to the public.
cards.short_summary: A public collection of government documents and maps.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University says Alden’s Government Documents and Maps collections are open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Located on Alden Library’s fifth floor; use the library during its posted operating hours.

cards.title: Set up a no-cost reading or study hang at Alden
cards.subtitle: 30 Park Place, Ohio University
cards.notes: Meet before 10 p.m., choose a library floor that suits your group’s noise level, and bring your own reading or class materials for a low-key session.
cards.short_summary: Public daytime access to Ohio University’s main library.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries states that Alden Library is open to the public during operating hours before 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Library Hours and Building Access | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Public access is available before 10 p.m.; after 10 p.m., a valid Ohio University ID is required.

cards.title: Browse the Dairy Barn Holiday Bazaar
cards.subtitle: Dairy Barn Arts Center, 8000 Dairy Lane
cards.notes: Go with a friend to look at handmade work and meet participating artists; browsing and admission are free, while any purchases remain completely optional.
cards.short_summary: A December craft event with free entry.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dairy Barn lists its Holiday Bazaar as a yearly event and states that admission is free to attend.
cards.source_title: Craft Festivals | The Dairy Barn Arts Center
cards.access_notes: The listed 2026 Holiday Bazaar dates are December 11–12; entry is free, but vendors may offer items for purchase.

cards.title: Watch for a free Dairy Barn opening reception
cards.subtitle: Dairy Barn Arts Center, 8000 Dairy Lane
cards.notes: Check the Dairy Barn’s exhibition announcements, then go early to view new work and talk about what catches your attention; refreshments may be available.
cards.short_summary: Free public receptions for new Dairy Barn exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dairy Barn described its exhibition opening reception as free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Opening Reception | The Dairy Barn Arts Center
cards.access_notes: This source documents a free public reception; check the Dairy Barn’s current calendar for the next opening date.

cards.title: Attend a Kennedy Lecture Series talk
cards.subtitle: Ohio University Athens Campus
cards.notes: Check the series calendar for a speaker and bring a classmate to compare takeaways afterward; Ohio University describes every event as free and open to the public.
cards.short_summary: A campus lecture series open without admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University states that all Kennedy Lecture Series events are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the specific event’s time, location, and any accessibility details through Ohio University’s calendar.
